note: postject ships dist/api.js and dist/cli.js as prebuilt tarball contents only — they are NOT present in the nodejs/postject git tree (dist/ is a build-time artifact of `npm run build`, absent even at the v1.0.0-alpha.6 tag). A git commit sha therefore cannot pin these exact bytes; pinnedSha is the npm registry's own tarball integrity hash instead, which is the authoritative identity for the bytes we vendored. Verified live 2026-07-27 against https://registry.npmjs.org/postject/1.0.0-alpha.6 .
renameNote: dist/api.js is vendored on disk as api.cjs (content byte-identical — see hash below) so Node's ESM loader treats it as CommonJS without a nested package.json; helm/package.json sets "type": "module" and api.js's require()/module.exports would otherwise fail to parse.
